best_human.provenance: Brouwer's table attributes A(17,6) >= 258 to Moshe Milshtein. The construction is an overall-parity extension of his length-16, distance-5 code.
best_human.evidence_state: published_lower_bound; word list unavailable and not independently reproduced

best_public.evidence_state: public lower bound; not an independently verified witness; table gives upper bound 340
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.provenance: Primitive binary BCH [15,7,5] code generated by x^8+x^7+x^6+x^4+1, extended by an overall parity bit and one zero coordinate.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Witness generated from the stated polynomial and all 128 messages; all pairs were checked by the task validator.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: witness and pairwise minimum distance independently checked exactly

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: reconstruction of a published human method; weaker than best public record
